teaser: An agentic team's token bill is mostly a design choice: files as memory, caching, code where you can, the right model per step, static outputs, counting.
core_idea: Most of an agentic team's token cost is design. From our runs: files as memory with hand-overs (106 on Storm Charles), caching repeated rules (98.7% of 3.84 billion tokens were cache reads), code instead of models where possible, the right model per step ($0.068 on open models against $1.99 on Sonnet), no pasted context, static outputs, and an accountant agent counting cost per role.

quotes.why: The bill is a design choice.

quotes.text: A long conversation is an expensive memory
